name: Website Ventures Selected Assets Registry
purpose: Single integration contract between approved Website Ventures visual winners and the coded Agency/Plumbing pages. A page may only load a media file when the corresponding slot status is exactly 'selected'.
rules: Pending slots must never break or visually replace the coded placeholder.
Only selected winners enter this registry; exploration variants remain outside live page integration.
selectedPath must be a repository-relative path to a real committed asset before status becomes selected.
Agency desktop and mobile hero are separate slots so mobile never silently relies on an accidental desktop crop.
Plumbing story slots use the same recurring PL-CHAR-001 identity, but PL-CHAR-001 itself is a reference master rather than a mandatory visible website slot.
Real client proof and reviews are never routed through this AI/demo asset registry.
Changing a selectedPath should be sufficient to swap an approved visual without editing page markup.

agency.hero.desktop.purpose: Agency hero desktop source used inside the right-column hero stage and first-scroll response.

agency.hero.mobile.purpose: Deliberate 4:5 mobile derivative of the selected agency desktop hero.

agency.showcase.plumbing.desktop.purpose: Real desktop browser capture of the actual coded Plumbing demo; not generated AI proof.

agency.showcase.plumbing.mobile.purpose: Real ~390px mobile capture of the actual coded Plumbing demo; not generated AI proof.

plumbing.character.master.purpose: Recurring technician identity reference for all generated Plumbing scenes. Reference master; not automatically rendered on the website.

plumbing.hero.purpose: Approved primary Plumbing hero visual. May initially point to a selected Batch 7 scene and later be upgraded to PL-HERO-MASTER-001 without markup changes.

plumbing.story.trust.purpose: Arrival/trust scene shown at Plumbing story beat 03 after approval.

plumbing.story.diagnosis.purpose: Diagnosis scene shown at Plumbing story beat 04 after approval.

plumbing.story.service.purpose: Under-sink/service scene shown at Plumbing story beat 05 after approval.
